title.narrative: Sierra Leone: Public Financial Management Improvement and Consolidation

description.narrative:
"The project development objective (PDO) is: “to improve budget planning and credibility, financial control, accountability and oversight in government finances in Sierra Leone”. Through strengthened institutional capacity for the delivery of effective PFM and oversight, the project will contribute to enhancing fiscal discipline, strategic allocation of resources and efficient service delivery. The inclusion of ‘budget credibility’ (constituting PFM performance levels under PEFA performance indicators 1 to 3) in the definition of project objectives recognizes the linkage of a credible budget with ‘predictability’ of resource flows to service delivery agencies.
With this objective, a sound PFM system will be established and nurtured under the proposed project to contribute to poverty reduction as: (i) it serves as a prerequisite for long-term and sustainable poverty reduction, enabling the country to manage its own development; (ii) it helps ensure that budget planning and discipline are compatible with macroeconomic stability, resource allocation is in line with poverty reduction strategies, activities are implemented efficiently, and results are followed up; (iii) national policies are translated into action through the PFM system, and services are thus delivered; and (iv) democratic governance entails democratic control over resources."
Incoming Commitment(Cumulative Signed Contribution)-as of June 30th, 2020
